connector.name: three.ws Agent Payments
connector.registryDescription: Governed x402 payment sessions: pay any endpoint with budget, allowlist & per-tx caps, no key.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package agentcore-payments-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: THREE_WS_SESSION
env.description: Your three.ws session token (value of the `__Host-sid` cookie from a signed-in browser). Required for account management operations: create_payment_session, list_payment_sessions, check_payment_session, cancel_payment_session.

env.name: PAYMENT_SESSION_TOKEN
env.description: A payment session bearer token (starts with 'pss_') from create_payment_session. Used by the agent for pay_with_session calls when no inline token is passed. Treat like a spending card — it authorizes payments up to the session's budget.

env.name: THREE_WS_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the three.ws API. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

env.name: THREE_WS_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-request HTTP timeout in milliseconds. x402 payments involve on-chain settlement so this should be generous (default: 30000).
